patient.description: Submit dental case through a well-organized system that ensures accurate case review, appropriate treatment, and matching with nearby dental students based on your geographic location.

student.description: Access real patient cases through an organized system that saves time, ensures accurate case selection, and helps you manage treatments efficiently.
